breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the user's flawed instruction by stating that the adiabatic-tip solution should be used, as the fin is described as having an adiabatic tip. The agent, however, acknowledged the contradiction ('even though it is “stated adiabatic tip”') but then proceeded to follow the user's incorrect instruction to use the convective-tip formula. This perpetuates the error instead of correcting it.
